biotools.summary: The Canadian VirusSeq Data Portal provides open access to Canadian SARS-CoV-2 genomic sequences and contextual data, while Duotang presents dynamic analyses and visualizations of circulating variants. Both resources are part of a larger network focused on open data sharing and public health communication.
